messages:
lee: Quick note: launching narrow admin-entitlement prune next week. Goal: remove stale admin bindings and validate KMS accesses before removal.

harper: Threshold? I'd prefer 90d for humans, 180d for service accounts unless tagged `quarterly-job`.

chun: Agree. We'll include last_api_call + last_console_login in the report. For KMS principals we also capture last_decrypt_time.

rbac-bot: precheck: scanned 1,900 principals; flagged 64 admin-level bindings and 22 KMS key ACLs with non-owner principals. Summary: https://internal/reports/access-prune-2451234567 (restricted).

lee: Canary plan: pick 3 low-risk services across infra/analytics, demote admin->viewer on flagged non-owner principals for 48h, monitor job failures and error-rate. If no issues, proceed with phased sweep and 7-day owner ping window.

harper: KMS safety: run an impersonated decrypt probe for each principal before policy changes. If probe fails, mark `needs-owner-review` and don't auto-remove.

chun: Snippet for probe:
```bash
gcloud kms decrypt --ciphertext-file=ct.bin --location=global --keyring=kr --key=k --project=proj --impersonate-service-account=${PRINCIPAL}
```
If exit code != 0 => skip.

lee: Runbook: `infra/tools/rbac-restore --snapshot gs://compliance/snap-2451234567/batch-<n>.json` and tag resources `prune-rollback=<batch>`. We'll keep immutable snapshots.

harper: Owner ping template: "Hi @owner, security is running an entitlement hygiene pass. `<principal>` holds `<role>` on `<resource>` and shows no activity since `<last_seen>`. Reply within 7 days to request exemption or tag `prune:exempt=true`. Non-response => demotion."

chun: Action items:
- chun: produce CSV with principal, role, last_seen, kms_last_decrypt, recommended_action (ETA Thu)
- harper: implement decrypt probe and whitelist tag detection (ETA Wed)
- lee: schedule canary + snapshot bucket + owner ping copy (ETA Wed)

lee: Will kick off canary Monday 09:00 PT. Keep this thread for live updates. React with :lock: when you've reviewed.
